name: [Update Log + New Badges] Pedagondia Faunas🌎
desc:
Pedagondia Faunas is a creature survival/combat game that takes place on the Pedagondian continent of Fantasy Earth. Play as one of the many unique and bizarre creatures of Pedagondia, some of which have abilities. Form packs together for better chances of survival, or simply to socialize. Explore and discover the mysteries of the past and the present. 

🖥️Controls 
- WASD: Move 
- Shift: Sprint 
- Sprint + Jump: Start Flying 
- Click: Attack/Eat/Drink 
- V: Use Scent 
- X: Ability (Only works for specific creatures) 
- R: Rest 
- Numpads: Make Sound (Roar) 
- F: Secondary Attack

⚠️Warning: Breaking Roblox ToS, High Toxicity and Exploiting can get you banned from the game
